verdict.rationale: Crossplane's documented interface is declarative Kubernetes APIs that humans, automation and AI agents all act on. It works with standard Kubernetes tooling, so the API is the primary surface rather than a secondary one trailing a UI. missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of API/UI parity (no UI is described, so parity is inferred), and independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic coverage of every operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Expose declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on
enable consumers, whether human users, automated workflows, or AI agents, to self-service
declarative APIs that make intent explicit, auditable, and and machine-readable
It's built on Kubernetes, so it works with all the Kubernetes tools you already use.
